class.name: TrainUniversalController
class.brief_description: Represents the universal controller in a train.
class.description: [TrainUniversalController] is a train part that handles the universal controller, grouping traction and braking controls together as defined by the [code]UCList[/code] configuration in MaSzyna. It handles positions that map to both traction and braking states.

members.member: [code]Cntrl:UniCtrlIntegratedBrakeCtrl[/code] Determines whether the integrated brake (ED/HD/auxiliary pneumatic) is supported on this controller.
[code]Cntrl:UniCtrlIntegratedBrakePNCtrl[/code] Determines whether the train's pneumatic brake is supported on this controller.
[code]UCList[/code] An array of [UniversalControllerListItem] resources defining the controller's positions.
The current position of the controller selector.
